gameDescriptionHtml:
Ready. Set. Dash!

Jump into Chasers Dash & Bash – a playful, pick-up-and-play competition where every match is full of colorful action, surprising strategies, and fun for all ages.

Solo or with friends, dash through obstacle courses, steal crystals, soar through the sky, and turn the tide with power-up items. It’s all about clever plays, quick moves, and lighthearted mischief.

Game Features

  • Game Modes – Explore a mix of modes that keep matches fresh, exciting, and unpredictable: Triathlon Race – Run, drive, and fly in multi-part obstacle races; Battle Royale – Be the last Chaser standing! Outlast everyone in a shrinking arena; Crystal Chase – Steal and collect as a team; Touchdown – Carry the crystal to the end zone; Classic Battle – Mayhem in its purest form; Practice Stages – Hone your skills in 3 special maps.
  • Grand Cups – Embark on your Chaser’s journey through the Grand Cups. Win matches, earn XP, and unlock new stages, and 12 fully-voiced characters, each with multiple skins to discover. Whether you’re chasing higher scores or just unlocking everything, every match moves you forward.
  • Power-Up Items – Pick up one item in each hand and make your move! Blast, block, and bounce your way to victory with tools that reward timing and creativity – from rolling beetles to tricky traps.
  • Move Your Way – Run, ride, or fly. Hop into karts, buses, jetpacks, or flying machines to chase shortcuts and surprise your rivals. And when the moment’s right, give your teammate a lift… or catch one yourself!
  • Split Screen & Online Play – Bring the fun to the couch or the world stage; Up to 12-player matches; Split screen for up to 4 players (even online!); Stage voting, team selection, and plenty of laughs; Great for family nights, parties, or friendly rivalries.
